messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your Apple ID (richard@highwayman.com) was used to sign in to iMessage on an iPhone 5.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'When you were watching videos, your web browser started out functioning as a Remote control Desktop having a keylogger which gave me access to your display screen and also webcam.', 'This is to inform all Subscribers that our server upgrade/maintenance is scheduled for September 1st 2011.', '- Please reconfigure your Microsoft Outlook information again.', 'To avoid being denied access to district resources such as email, network shares, etc.', 'Your Apple ID, was just used to download Vodafone Mobile@Work from the App Store on a computer or device that had not previously been associated with that Apple ID.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
